reason: Conversation 1 asserted an unsupported alternative meaning (E011 as a temperature-sensor fault) and framed the moisture issue as a 'short circuit' rather than a held-key detection, and it closed without any cleaning advice or recurrence/escalation guidance. Conversation 2 resolved the fault in a single safe step, explicitly set the safety boundary ('do not remove the control panel or any covers'), gave a clear escalation trigger if E011 returns on a dry panel, and added practical prevention tips (spray onto cloth, dry around buttons). Conversation 2's opening was awkwardly truncated and it never explicitly named the 'key pressed too long' meaning, but it stayed honest about uncertainty rather than inventing a wrong cause, and its overall guidance was more complete and correct.
